title: 第564章 进入秘境第563章 卖宝物
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“这块是逃脱符箓，一旦捏碎可以瞬间移出千里之外，是逃命的好东西，而且仅此一个，售价为2000极品灵石，你们谁买？”
慕容龙手里拿着这块金色符箓说道，介绍了其作用，他目光炯炯的看着在场的所有人开始推销。
“什么，2000极品灵石，你疯了吧，这东西这么贵？”
“就是，虽然能逃脱，但是卖2000极品灵石太贵点。”
“慕容宫主，你太黑了点吧。”
……
听到慕容龙的话，在场的人议论纷纷起来，不是逃脱符箓不好，而是卖的太贵了点。
2000极品灵石能购买多少好东西了啊，买这个似乎不值得。
“呵呵，贵是贵了点，但是这可是能救命的东西，危急时刻足够你们做很多事情了，比如哪天你们在外面遭遇到了实力强悍的仇家或者妖兽，你就捏碎这个逃脱符箓，可以瞬间移动千里之外，这可是能救命的。”
慕容龙继续说道。
“呵呵，老夫可是天南赫赫有名的高手，就算在天南真有老夫打不过的人，比如元婴期修士，但是老夫从他手里逃走一点问题都没有，这个逃脱符箓对我而言完全是鸡肋，老夫是不会买的。”
司徒南抱着双手冷笑道。
司徒南是金丹期大圆满的强者，实力接近假婴了，能击败他的人很少，想要杀他自然难如登天。
这逃脱符箓对他自然没什么用。
“没错，我星耀自认为实力还行，谁想要杀我怕不是那么容易，2000极品灵石够我玩多少妞了，去买这么个东西不值得。”
星耀则也笑嘻嘻的说道，他的大手依旧在使劲的揉捏身边的练气女修的高耸峰峦，将对方的胸都捏肿了。
“没错，这对我而言也没什么用的。”
“主要是太贵了，不值得。”
……
其余的人也纷纷说道，认为这个东西有点贵，性价比太低了，2000极品灵石买一个一次性逃命的东西，怎么也不划算。

“我买了。”
不过就在此刻，忽然一个声音响了起来，说话的自然不是别人，正是云峰。
云峰手一动从身上空间法器里摸出来一个鼓鼓的袋子，里面装的自然是2000极品灵石。
“呵呵，这位道友果然识货，把东西拿给他。”
看到云峰要买，一边的慕容龙大喜，其实这个逃脱符箓他都卖了很多次了，一直没卖出去，因为舍得花钱的修士太少了。
很快的功夫，星月湖侍女就拿着逃脱符箓递给了云峰，然后拿了云峰的2000灵石袋子，完成了交易。
“他好有钱？”
“妈的，筑基期修士，怎么这么有钱？”
“等会到了秘境里抢劫他。”
……
看到云峰这么有钱，虚空殿里的人则惊呆了议论纷纷起来，他们在看清楚云峰的境界后则起了贪婪之心。
毕竟能随手拿出2000极品灵石的人，自然是大肥羊了，如果云峰是金丹期修为的话他们自然不敢动，但是偏偏云峰才筑基初期，这好比一个六岁小孩拿着金砖在街头上跑，这不就是找死吗。
“云兄弟，你不要这样，财不外露。”
坐在云峰身边的周姓修士则皱了皱眉，对着云峰小声说道，毕竟眼前的这些虚空殿里的修仙者最弱的也到了筑基期后期了，强的更是进入了金丹期。
content_en:
"This is an escape talisman. Once crushed, it can be moved thousands of miles away instantly. It is a good thing for escaping. And it is the only one. It is priced at 2,000 top-quality spiritual stones. Which of you will buy it?"
Murong Long held the golden talisman in his hand and said, introducing its function, he looked at everyone present with bright eyes and started to sell it.
"What, 2,000 top-quality spiritual stones, are you crazy? This thing is so expensive?"
"That's right, although I can escape, selling 2,000 top-quality spiritual stones is too expensive."
"Palace Master Murong, you are too dark."
…
After hearing Murong Long's words, everyone present started talking. It wasn't that the escape talisman was not good, but that it was too expensive.
How many good things can you buy with 2000 top-quality spiritual stones? It doesn’t seem worth buying this.
"Haha, it's a bit expensive, but this is something that can save lives. It's enough for you to do a lot of things in critical moments. For example, if you encounter a powerful enemy or monster outside, you can crush this escape talisman and you can teleport thousands of miles away. This can save lives."
Murong Long continued.
"Haha, I am a famous master in Tiannan. Even if there are people in Tiannan that I cannot beat, such as Yuanying Stage monks, I will have no problem escaping from him. This escape talisman is completely useless to me, and I will not buy it."
Situ Nan folded his hands and sneered.
Situ Nan is a strong man in the Golden Core stage of Dzogchen. His strength is close to that of a false infant. There are very few people who can defeat him. It is naturally difficult to kill him.
This escape talisman is of course of no use to him.
"That's right, I, Xingyao, think that my strength is pretty good. Anyone who wants to kill me may not be that easy. 2,000 top-quality spiritual stones are enough for me to play with many girls. It's not worth it to buy such a thing."
Xingyao also said with a smile. His big hands were still vigorously kneading the towering peaks of the female Qi practitioner next to him, making her breasts swell.
"Yeah, that's no use to me either."
"The main reason is that it's too expensive and not worth it."
…
The rest of the people also said that they thought this thing was a bit expensive and the price-performance ratio was too low. It was not cost-effective to buy a one-time escape thing for 2,000 top-quality spiritual stones.
"I bought it."
But at this moment, a voice suddenly rang out, and the speaker was naturally none other than Yun Feng.
Yunfeng moved his hand and took out a bulging bag from the space magic weapon on his body. Naturally, it contained 2,000 top-quality spiritual stones.
"Haha, this Taoist friend really knows the stuff, give him the stuff."
Seeing that Yunfeng wanted to buy it, Murong Long was overjoyed. In fact, he had sold this escape talisman many times, but he had never sold it because there were too few monks willing to spend money.
In a short time, the maid of Xingyue Lake handed the escape talisman to Yunfeng, then took Yunfeng's bag of 2,000 spirit stones and completed the transaction.
"Is he so rich?"
"Damn, how come you, a foundation-building monk, are so rich?"
"We'll rob him in the secret realm later."
…
Seeing that Yunfeng was so rich, the people in the Void Palace were shocked and started talking. After they saw Yunfeng's realm clearly, they became greedy.
After all, anyone who can easily take out 2,000 top-quality spiritual stones is a big fat sheep. If Yunfeng is at the Golden Core stage, they will naturally not dare to move. However, Yunfeng is only at the early stage of foundation building. This is like a six-year-old child running on the street with a gold brick. Isn't this just asking for death?
"Brother Yun, don't do this. Don't expose your wealth."
The monk surnamed Zhou who was sitting next to Yun Feng frowned and whispered to Yun Feng. After all, the weakest of the immortal cultivators in the Void Palace in front of him had reached the late foundation building stage, and the strongest ones had entered the golden elixir stage.
